extraction.name: EuroSAT
extraction.description: A novel dataset and deep learning benchmark for land use and land cover classification
extraction.creator: Patrick Helber, Benjamin Bischke, Andreas Dengel, Damian Borth
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The EuroSAT dataset was created using multi-spectral image data provided by the Sentinel-2A satellite. The dataset consists of 27,000 georeferenced and labeled image patches, covering 10 different land use and land cover classes.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data was collected from the Sentinel-2A satellite, which provides openly and freely accessible Earth observation data.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The image patches were manually checked and corrected for mislabeled images and images full of snow or ice.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The dataset was annotated by manually labeling 27,000 image patches into 10 different land use and land cover classes.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset has potential applications in land use and land cover change detection, and assisting in keeping geographical maps up-to-date.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset has not received atmospheric correction, which can result in images with a color cast.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset can be used for land use and land cover classification, change detection, and assisting in keeping geographical maps up-to-date.
